newsitem.title: USA: Boston Scientific Q1 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Boston Scientific Q1 below estimates.

text.p: Boston Scientific Corp said on Thursday it expects first quarter earnings to be significantly below the consensus of analysts' estimates, since currency fluctuations hurt revenues.
First Call's consensus for the company's first quarter earnings was $0.47 a share.

Net sales for the first quarter increased 24 percent to $399 million as compared to $322 million in the first quarter of 1996, Boston Scientific said. Without the impact of changes in exchange rates, net sales for the first quarter increased 27 percent, Boston Scientific said.

Pete Nicholas, Boston Scientific's chairman and chief executive officer, said, "Solid growth was again experienced in both the U.S. and international markets. We continue to work very hard at expanding our global presence."
The Company plans to announce complete financial results for the first quarter later in the month.
In last year's first quarter the company reported a loss of $0.01 a share, after a charge related to purchased research and development.
